mapper.select: select * from nad_application where applicant_id = #{applicantId} order by create_time desc
select applicant_id from nad_application where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into nad_application (applicant_id, application_type, program_id, scholarship_id, intake_id, workflow_instance_id, current_stage_id, current_status, version, create_by, create_time) values (#{applicantId}, #{applicationType}, #{programId}, #{scholarshipId}, #{intakeId}, #{workflowInstanceId}, #{currentStageId}, #{currentStatus}, #{version}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update nad_application set current_stage_id = #{app.currentStageId}, current_status = #{app.currentStatus}, workflow_instance_id = #{app.workflowInstanceId}, assignee_user_id = #{app.assigneeUserId}, submitted_at = #{app.submittedAt}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{app.updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{app.id} and version = #{expectedVersion}
update nad_application set program_id = #{programId}, scholarship_id = #{scholarshipId}, intake_id = #{intakeId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update nad_application set workflow_instance_id = #{workflowInstanceId} where id = #{id}
